# pve_user_unlock_tfa (Action)

Unlock a user's TFA after too many failed attempts.

## Example Usage

```terraform
action "pve_user_unlock_tfa" "example" {
  config {
  userid = "CHANGE_ME"
  }
}

# terraform_data is a no-op stand-in; wire action.pve actions to the
# lifecycle events of any managed resource.
resource "terraform_data" "trigger" {
  lifecycle {
    action_trigger {
      events  = [after_create]
      actions = [action.pve_user_unlock_tfa.example]
    }
  }
}
```

<!-- action schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `userid` (String) Full User ID, in the `name@realm` format.
